resumeText: Ruby Foster is a Database Administrator at Falconer Insurance with three years of experience keeping production PostgreSQL databases healthy. She tunes performance, writes and reviews SQL, and manages cloud databases on Linux with automated backups. Her production experience so far is single-node; she is building toward replication and high-availability design and is excited to grow into a database reliability role.
